en: Added automatic hot-state archiving, Storage controls in Settings (separating lossless archiving from permanent output cleanup), and the `arc cli storage` commands.
zh-CN: 新增热态数据自动归档、设置页中的存储管理控件（将无损归档与永久清理输出分开），以及 `arc cli storage` 命令行工具。

en: Reduced idle CPU, memory churn, and disk writes by tuning Go GC limits, lowering idle desktop polling, and removing redundant AX writes, coordination spins, and per-request lease RPCs.
zh-CN: 通过调优 Go GC 内存策略、降低桌面端空闲轮询频率，并消除冗余的 AX 写入、协调空转和逐请求租约 RPC，进一步降低空闲 CPU、内存抖动与磁盘写入。

en: Unified homepage connection wire rules so left control sources reflect authorization and tunnel readiness, and right agents (including Codex) reflect detection and dispatchability.
zh-CN: 统一主页连线规则：左侧控制源仅依据授权状态与隧道在线判定，右侧 Agent（含 Codex）统一依据检测到且可派发判定。

en: Kept device-link peer LAN listeners active when mDNS multicast fails on startup, and restored live Codex Desktop and App Server readiness reporting in status diagnostics.
zh-CN: 修复启动时 mDNS 多播失败导致跨设备局域网端口监听被关闭的问题，并恢复状态诊断中 Codex Desktop 与 App Server 的真实就绪度上报。

en: Restored native macOS File and Services menus, native Windows titlebar window buttons, and Windows Antigravity `agentapi.bat` / `language_server.exe` discovery.
zh-CN: 恢复 macOS 原生“文件”与“服务”菜单、Windows 原生标题栏窗口按钮，以及 Windows 下 Antigravity `agentapi.bat` 与 `language_server.exe` 的自动发现。
